what: HRRR's maximum weight in the wind lane blend by region and lead (hours from the HRRR cycle), read by wind_lane_skill.py only when WIND_LANE_SKILL_WEIGHTS=1. Linear in lead between the fitted leads, held flat outside them.

fit.script: backend/scripts/sweep_wind_lane_weight.py on the rows of backend/scripts/grade_wind_lane_ndbc.py
fit.truth: NDBC realtime2 buoy wind at the valid time (+-30 min), adjusted to 10 m (power law 0.11), full-weight buoys only
fit.split: fit on odd rows ((day of month + cycle hour / 6) odd), scored on the even rows; w grid 0.0..1.0 step 0.1
fit.regions: west = WMO 46 buoys (Pacific); east = WMO 41/42/44 (Atlantic + Gulf, pooled: the Gulf's 4 buoys are under n 300)
